name: Craftsman's Writ: Colorful Kilt
label: Quest
description: A customer requests a Colorful Kilt through a transferable writ. The garment is meant to help the customer blend in at Zul'Gurub.
intro: A customer requests a Colorful Kilt through a transferable writ. The garment is meant to help the customer blend in at Zul'Gurub.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Colorful Kilt, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Keep ya' head down, mon! Dey be watching...

clips.title: Completion
paras: I plan to be sneakin' into the gates of Zul'Gurub soon, but I need the gear to blend in. Thinkin' I gear up like one of their ritualists.
This colorful kilt is exactly what I be needin'.
